name: pulsechain-token-transfer
description: Utilities for PulseChain: how much of a token one transaction sent a wallet, wallet balances at a block, the price ratio of two tokens, a wallet's history from the chain alone, and its sweep against Summ

scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && markdownlint-cli2 && npm run format:check && github-actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml && npm run knip:files
scripts.audit:deps: npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev && npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --prefix chart-price-ratio && npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --prefix check-token-balance
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:deps && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:secrets
